subject: Reseller go-live migration plan for AWS Marketplace - CPPO steps
messages:
From: Samantha Liao <samantha@kitecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner SA <aws-psa@amazon.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — Marketplace migration + CPPO for ResellCo

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through the Marketplace proposals this week. We want to get the resell go-live scheduled for late Nov and need to align CPPO entitlement mapping, billing routing, and the reseller listing change window.

Attached is a simple migration_matrix.xlsx with our current state (what’s live today) and the proposed target SKUs for the CPPO. A few asks to start:
- Can Redwood confirm the entitlement mapping flow (Marketplace product -> CPPO SKU -> Reseller entitlement)?
- Who owns invoice routing for initial POs (ResellCo vs KiteCloud)?
- Any doc or template you need from our procurement team for the PO/DocuSign?

I’ve looped Finn (ResellCo) and the AWS PSA to help with CPPO onboarding on their side. We can do a short checkpoint next week.

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Partnerships, KiteCloud
attachments: [migration_matrix.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liao <samantha@kitecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, AWS Partner SA <aws-psa@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Marketplace migration + CPPO for ResellCo

Samantha — thanks for the matrix. Quick acknowledgement and proposed next steps:

1) Internal owners: Ben (billing & listings) will drive invoice routing; Diego (partner ops) will own entitlement mapping and CPPO setup. I’ll coordinate the runbook and DocuSign artifacts.
2) Can you confirm whether KiteCloud will accept an invoice to their entity for the initial PO or if ResellCo needs to be the billed entity? We need that to set up the CPPO mapping in AWS (payee entity).
3) I’ve suggested a 30-min checkpoint on Tue 10/19 to validate the matrix and call out any SKU gaps. Does that work?

Ben/Diego — marking action owners below so we have a single place to track:
- Ben: validate billing entity flow and confirm invoice routing template
- Diego: review migration_matrix.xlsx and propose CPPO entitlement mapping (format: marketplace sku -> cppo sku -> reseller entitlements)
- Marissa: prepare reseller_migration_runbook_v1 draft and DocuSign PO checklist

If that plan looks good I’ll send calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Liao <samantha@kitecloud.com>, Finn O'Reilly <finn@resellco.io>, AWS Partner SA <aws-psa@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Marketplace migration + CPPO for ResellCo

Quick notes from my side after a first pass on the migration_matrix:

- Invoice routing: Redwood supports both reseller-billed and vendor-billed PO patterns, but CPPO in AWS requires the buyer entity to be consistent with the PO. Practically: if ResellCo will invoice KiteCloud, the CPPO needs to map the billing fields to the reseller account. If KiteCloud is paying Redwood directly, we use our vendor relationship and route to Redwood invoicing.
- Action item: Samantha/Finn — confirm which entity (KiteCloud or ResellCo) signs/receives the first PO; I’ll prepare the template for both flows.
- DocuSign: prefer a single DocuSign envelope per deal (ResellCo signs reseller addendum + KiteCloud signs PO) to simplify tracking.

I’ll prepare two short templates (reseller-billed PO / vendor-billed PO) and attach a link to the HubSpot deal.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: none
related_links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321/RC-2027-1123

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Liao <samantha@kitecloud.com>, Finn O'Reilly <finn@resellco.io>, AWS Partner SA <aws-psa@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Marketplace migration + CPPO for ResellCo

Team — I reviewed the migration matrix and drafted a CPPO entity map (attached) with the following highlights:

- Proposed mapping: marketplace_sku A -> cppo_sku A1 -> reseller entitlements (ResellCo account id: 987-RESELL). I flagged three SKUs that need product renaming to align with CPPO constraints.
- Entitlement gating: we will need ResellCo to complete the AWS entitlement form (I’ll send the AWS template). Without the entitlement ID we can’t finish the CPPO setup.
- Billing nuance: if ResellCo is to be the billed entity we must confirm tax entity (VAT/US EIN) for the invoice header — this can delay CPPO activation by 2-3 business days if missing.

Attached: aws-cppo-entity-map.pdf (mapping + notes)

Next steps (owners and ETA):
- Finn/ResellCo: provide entitlement IDs + tax entity info — due 10/20 EOD
- Ben: prepare both PO templates and DocuSign envelope — due 10/19 EOD
- Marissa: share runbook draft and schedule 10/19 checkpoint — due 10/18 EOD

Diego
Partner Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: [aws-cppo-entity-map.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liao <samantha@kitecloud.com>, Finn O'Reilly <finn@resellco.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, AWS Partner SA <aws-psa@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Marketplace migration + CPPO for ResellCo — consolidated next steps

Thanks everyone — clean consolidation below following Diego and Ben’s inputs. We’ll treat this as the single source of truth ahead of the 10/29 go-live window.

Consolidated action list (owners / due):
- ResellCo (Finn): entitlement IDs + tax entity (EIN/VAT) — due 2027-10-20 EOD.
- Ben: finalize two PO templates (reseller-billed, vendor-billed) + single DocuSign envelope — due 2027-10-19 EOD.
- Diego: finalize CPPO mapping in AWS and flag SKU rename requirements — due 2027-10-22 EOD.
- Marissa: publish reseller_migration_runbook_v1 and send 10/19 checkpoint invite — published and attached (reseller_migration_runbook_v1.pdf).

Checkpoint: Tue 19 Oct 2027, 09:00 PT (30 min) — calendar invite sent. Please come with entitlement IDs and any procurement language you need included in the DocuSign PO.

If anyone needs to escalate a dependency (legal, tax, or AWS entitlement form), flag me directly and I’ll loop in our sales legal and AWS PSA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: [reseller_migration_runbook_v1.pdf]
